description.value:
Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“The wheels were full of eyes. You never stop turning. You never stop seeing.”

Sephirotic Scion (Ophanic). Order: turning, seeing. Motion and sight are the same thing to you.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Wheel-and-Eye. When you move at least 10 ft on your turn, gain reroll-lowest on Perception checks involving motion, pattern, or change over time until the start of your next turn.
  • Never Still. See your signature feat, The Wheel Never Stops.
  • Concentric Sight. You do not grant positional advantage from side or rear arcs if your table uses flanking. Where flanking is not in play, enemies within 5 ft of you cannot gain the help bonus from a second attacker.
  • Signature. You gain The Wheel Never Stops at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.
